public abstract class AbstractManager extends Object
Base class for all GeoServer REST API managers.

Provides common CRUD helpers that:

  • Serialize request DTOs → wire format (JSON/XML)
  • Execute HTTP requests via GeoServerHttpClient
  • Deserialize response → DTOs
  • Map HTTP error codes to typed exceptions
  • Validate required parameters

Subclasses define business methods (e.g., list(), create()) and delegate to these helpers for the actual HTTP communication.

Thread safety: subclasses must hold only the constructor-injected fields (no per-call mutable instance state), so that any manager can be safely shared and called concurrently across threads — see GeoServerClient for the full guarantee.
